calls.statement:
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27') AS lines,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27') AS dist_line_id,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27')) AS dist_receipt_line,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line) AS returns,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) AS dist_ret_id,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS sales_lines_multi_returns,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)) AS orphan_returns,
 (SELECT max(return_date) FROM fact_return_line) AS max_ret,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=999 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27') AS l999

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cp.category AS cur_cat, cp.subcategory AS cur_sub, p.category AS was_cat, p.subcategory AS was_sub,
         s.store_id, wo.status
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND s.store_id=900
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
    AND (cp.category='Garden' OR p.category='Garden')
), ref AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) rn FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT cur_cat, cur_sub, was_cat, was_sub, count(*) n, SUM(net_amount) sold_net, COALESCE(SUM(rn),0) ret_net,
       ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(rn),0)/SUM(net_amount),2) rate,
       sum(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cancelled_lines,
       sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_lines
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ref USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

calls.statement:
SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, p.subcategory, p.valid_from, p.valid_to, p.is_current, p.listed_from, p.delisted_on,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.product_key=p.product_key) AS lines
FROM dim_product p
WHERE p.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' AND p.sku IN (
  SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' GROUP BY sku HAVING bool_or(category='Garden' AND is_current) OR count(*)=1)
ORDER BY p.sku, p.valid_from
LIMIT 60
